Chapter 742: Chapter 29: Numerous Wonders (Please Subscribe)

In the past two hundred years, Lin Yuan had also visited Heavenly Mountain.

But each time he observed, he still felt somewhat shocked.

Heavenly Mountain was probably around eighty or ninety thousand meters high, seemingly insignificant when compared with the vast stars in the Cosmic Starry Skies.

However, Lin Yuan could vaguely sense that the entire Heavenly Mountain was flowing with an inexplicable and mysterious aura.

This aura reminded Lin Yuan of the similar feeling he had when he was on the Ancestral Star of Human Civilization.

No, to be precise, the aura flowing from Heavenly Mountain was even more vast and profound than that of the Ancestral Star of Human Civilization.

...

“If Heavenly Mountain is already like this, I wonder what the scene will be like when the Sky Gate appears,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, quietly.

Although he had seen descriptions of the Sky Gate in many ancient texts and records,

the understandings of the Sky Gate by those native beings from the Two-dimensional World couldn’t even describe a tiny fraction of its reality.

Just like the towering Heavenly Mountain in front of him, in the eyes of the natives from the Two-dimensional World, it was merely a little taller and famous only because of the Sky Gate.

But in front of Lin Yuan, it was infinitely mysterious.

Sometimes, the higher one’s level of existence, the deeper the feeling and the more one knows and sees.

“The core area of this Two-dimensional World should be this Heavenly Mountain,” Lin Yuan speculated in his heart.

Here, the core area didn’t refer to the physical core but rather the place closest to the depths of the Two-dimensional World.

Just as Lin Yuan stopped and carefully observed the Heavenly Mountain not far away.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh.

One after another, formidable beings raced towards him.

These strong entities exuded powerful auras, releasing them without restraint, but upon seeing Lin Yuan, their expressions subtly changed.

“Isn’t that the mysterious powerhouse from Xueyu Ancient Country?”

“It should be him, the aura is similar, and he’s carrying that dark iron rod on his back.”

“I heard that two hundred years ago, this mysterious powerhouse only took two breaths to kill Pei Shen, and even with his defensive artifact, Tuoba Ancient God only lasted half a day…”

…

Six or seven powerhouses from the Myriad Tribes bowed respectfully from a distance towards Lin Yuan.

This time, Lin Yuan came without concealing his appearance, mainly because when he had moved against Tuoba Ancient God and other special beings before, he had exposed his aura.

Within the Two-dimensional World, the aura of every living being can’t be changed. In such a case, there was no need for Lin Yuan to hide his appearance.

Because he would be recognized anyway.

As for the dark iron rod on his back… since he couldn’t hide his identity, there wasn’t much point in keeping this special object inside the independent space contained within the silver mirror.

Because the enemies would certainly be wary of this move, it could expose the secret of the silver mirror instead.

Inside the space of the silver mirror, Lin Yuan stored other trump cards, such as the jade axe, an extremely sharp artifact, which was completely different in style from the dark iron rod.

Used at the right moment, it could completely play a role in changing the course of a battle.

In the distance.

The six or seven powerhouses from the Myriad Clans were still stealthily observing Lin Yuan.

“This mysterious powerhouse from Xueyu Ancient Country, not having made a move in the past two hundred years, still ranks among the top nine powerhouses, and although he’s only ninth, his strength is immeasurable.”

“To not have made a move for two hundred years and still be ranked ninth is terrifying.”

“Who knows what strength he possesses now.”

…

These few powerhouses from the Myriad Clans whispered amongst themselves. They came to see the Sky Gate this time with no intention of entering it, as the possibility was almost zero.

…

“It’s time to meet up with the human Evolvers,” Lin Yuan glanced at the six or seven powerhouses of the Myriad Clans in the distance without paying them too much attention.

Before his last retreat, the Xia Qin Supreme Being had instructed him to meet up with the Evolvers of Human Civilization after reaching Heavenly Mountain.

The purpose of this was to have all human civilization Evolvers fully assist Lin Yuan and strive for the possibility of entering the Sky Gate.

Although no one from the human civilization Evolvers had yet reached the level of the top nine powerhouses, the efforts of many Tier 11 Evolvers could still be somewhat effective.

Most importantly, having these human civilization Evolvers beside him meant Lin Yuan didn’t have to feel too much pressure.

As a Peak Clan, the Human Civilization, besides having the nine Supreme Beings, had unity as their most important attribute.

Going alone? Even those unique special beings were forced to establish the Star Alliance to confront the grand alliances of Peak Clans like human civilization and the Insect Race.

Moreover, if he could enter the Sky Gate, Lin Yuan still needed to acquire some special objects from Human Civilization to take with him.

He would have to make contact with the human civilization Evolvers then.

“I have the silver mirror. With the independent space inside it, even some special artifacts can be easily brought out,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Other powerhouses didn’t have the silver mirror and, even for the Four Divine Kings, at most, they could only take out ordinary artifacts.

Abnormally sized artifacts, such as objects several meters in size, would become inconvenient.

Without knowing whether they had to enter immediately after the Sky Gate opened, how could they carry an object of several meters in size with them?

That would only be a hindrance and drag down their combat capability.

…

Close to Heavenly Mountain.

Yan Fu, who had just entered the Witch Ancestor Realm, had harbored great ambitions, planning to showcase his strength at Heavenly Mountain to intimidate the Twelve Ancient Countries.

But before he even reached Heavenly Mountain, he couldn’t help but tremble.

“Isn’t it said that Witch Ancestor-level powerhouses are stable entrants into the Sky Gate? Wasn’t it said that in past Sky Gate openings, the competing powerhouses were only Witch Emperors?”

Yan Fu couldn’t understand. Along the way, he had cautiously sensed dozens of auras, all without exception at the Witch Ancestor level.

And in Yan Fu’s perception, it was far beyond the level of a Witch Ancestor like himself who had just entered the Realm.

This caused Yan Fu’s mentality to somewhat collapse. Having stepped into the Witch Ancestor Realm, he had originally thought he could dominate the world. But after sensing for a long time, he found himself to be the weakest among them?

“How could there be so many Witch Ancestors?” Yan Fu could not comprehend. He had transitioned from a Witch to Witch King, then to Witch Emperor, and now to a Witch Ancestor.

He knew all too well the difficulty of becoming a Witch Ancestor.

“Should I still go to Heavenly Mountain now?”

Yan Fu looked toward the distant Heavenly Mountain whose outline was faintly visible, and for a moment he hesitated.

The presence of dozens of powerful Witch Ancestor auras he sensed earlier made him somewhat fearful of the Heavenly Mountain in the distance.

He hadn’t even reached Heavenly Mountain yet, but with so many powerhouses around, once he got close, his life might even be in danger.

“Go.”

“I have cultivated for six hundred years, just to witness the Heavenly Gate. No matter how many powerhouses there are, nothing can stop me from heading to Heavenly Mountain.”

Eventually, Yan Fu, a one-in-a-million existence among native lives, quickly adjusted his mentality and continued toward Heavenly Mountain.

However, compared to before, Yan Fu was much more low-profile this time, not even daring to leak a hint of his breath, and he would stop every once in a while, survey his surroundings briefly, and then resume his journey.

…

At the foot of Heavenly Mountain.

Within a manor.

This was a stronghold of Human Civilization where the Heavenly Gate appeared. More than two or three hundred years ago, Evolvers from Human Civilization had rushed here to establish a base.

This was the advantage of having a powerful backing; they didn’t need to worry about minor matters, as specialized personnel had already taken care of them.

At this moment, deep within the manor.

More than twenty figures gathered.

All these figures were Tier 11 Evolvers from Human Civilization, sitting here as if they were waiting for something.

“The Supreme Being asked us to wait here, saying that an important figure from our Human Civilization would come.”

“Who exactly is this important figure, for whom the Supreme Being specifically gave orders?”

The many Tier 11 Evolvers were curious. Having cultivated to Tier 11, they already belonged to the top echelons of Human Civilization; most of the powerhouses within the clans were well known to each other. Yet they had no idea about this ‘important figure’ mentioned by the Supreme Being?

“According to the Supreme Being, we need to assist this important figure to the best of our abilities, even if it means sacrificing this avatar.”

A tall female Evolver spoke out, her tone slightly puzzled. For an important figure necessitating the sacrifice of an avatar for their assistance by these Tier 11 Evolvers, who could it be?

“Could it be that this important figure has the qualifications to compete for the Heavenly Gate’s spot?”

One of the Tier 11 Evolvers speculated.

“That must be the case.”

“Yes, otherwise it wouldn’t warrant the Supreme Being being so serious.”

“Our Human Civilization has such a person among the powerhouses who fell into this Two-dimensional World…”

The Tier 11 Evolvers conversed with each other, all highly curious about the important figure mentioned by the Supreme Being.

Among the more than twenty Tier 11 Evolvers, Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master sitting in a corner, was just quietly listening.

Although he was also a Tier 11 Evolver, he had only recently reached Tier 11 and there was a difference in status and position between him and the seasoned Tier 11s present.

“I wonder where the Galaxy Master is now?” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, pondered other matters in his mind.

In his view, the Galaxy Master had incredible talent, but there was still a significant gap compared to those Tier 11 Perfect legendary lives. The opening of the Heavenly Gate this time was probably just an occasion for observation.

Suddenly.

At that moment.

A figure appeared outside the manor.

All the Tier 11 Evolvers present immediately noticed.

“Someone is outside?”

“Is it the ‘important figure’ mentioned by the Supreme Being?”

The more than twenty Tier 11 Evolvers immediately rose to their feet and came outside the manor to greet the newcomer personally.

When they saw the face of the arrival and felt the aura, they were immediately taken aback.

“The mysterious powerhouse from Xueyu Ancient Country?”

“Over two hundred years ago, this mysterious powerhouse acted, killing both Tuoba Ancient God and Pei Shen, two Tier 11 special lives ranked in the fifth tier.”

“My goodness, this mysterious powerhouse from Xueyu Ancient Country comes from our Human Civilization?”

…

The tall female Tier 11 Evolver stepped forward and communicated with Lin Yuan to confirm his identity, and the rest of the Tier 11 Evolvers immediately erupted in excitement.

“May I ask how you are addressed?”

The tall woman spoke with a hint of respect, her name was Xuanyuan Dua, and in the Two-dimensional World, she was one of the strongest Evolvers among humans, being listed among the nine greatest powerhouses during the early days of arrival.

However, she was soon replaced.

“Just call me Xueyu,” Lin Yuan said casually.

In the Two-dimensional World, every powerhouse faced suppression, their aura completely different from the outer world, along with changes to their appearance and build, even altering their methods of combat.

Unless one acknowledged their identity, it was very difficult for others to deduce who they truly were.

“Lord Xueyu,”

The tall woman, Xuanyuan Dua, invited Lin Yuan into the manor and then opened a large chest, revealing many strange and wondrous objects inside.

“Then, I shall leave these wonders in your care, Lord Xueyu,” Xuanyuan Dua said gravely. The ten or so odd items in the chest were the results of what countless Evolvers from Human Civilization had gathered and searched for over the past three hundred years.

According to the Supreme Being’s intentions, all these wonders were to be handed over to Lin Yuan for safekeeping.

“These wonders…” Lin Yuan’s gaze swept over the many strange objects, his expression suddenly revealing surprise.
